summary: Iteration 4 — Object-storage scholarship-proof upload + admin download verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 27/27 PASSED (added 7 new tests: upload success, ext rejection, oversize rejection, unauth/non-admin/404 download, content-persistence). Frontend e2e: file picker (proof-file-pick / proof-file-input / proof-file-attached / proof-file-clear) works, scholarship form POSTs proof_file_id, admin Submissions tab renders 'View proof file' (download-proof-{id}) for submissions with proof_file_id, click triggers fetch /api/admin/files/{id} with Bearer token returning 200 + application/pdf. Content persistence (admin PUT → unauth GET) confirmed.

minor.issue: Pre-existing graceful Stripe fallback (note='pending_external_confirmation') — same as iteration_3, not in this iteration's scope.

critical_code_review_comments: storage_service.put_object/get_object correctly auto-reset _storage_key on 403 and re-init — good resilience for the emergent objstore session-key model.

/api/upload/scholarship-proof returns 503 when storage is unavailable instead of 500, with a user-friendly message hinting the link-paste fallback. Tests accommodate that with pytest.skip on 503 — appropriate.
FileRef has is_deleted flag and admin_download_file filters {is_deleted: False} — soft-delete-ready; consider exposing a deletion endpoint if/when admin needs to purge a file.

AdminPage downloadFile uses fetch(blob) + window.open(blobUrl) instead of <a download> — works but bypasses the Content-Disposition filename. Consider adding an <a> with download attribute for proper filename in the saved file. Minor UX.

EventScholarshipPage: file-size pre-check on client (10MB) and re-uploading after clear works; but if upload succeeds and form submission then fails, the uploaded blob orphans in storage. Acceptable for MVP — could be GC'd later.
AppContext 60s polling + window-focus refetch is good for site-wide admin propagation; consider exponential backoff if the tab is hidden long-term to reduce load.
server.py is now ~877 lines — recommend splitting into routers/uploads.py, routers/payments.py, routers/admin.py for maintainability.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') still uses deprecated APIs — migrate to lifespan context manager.
seed_data_creation: Tests upload a tiny TEST_proof.pdf via UI (TEST_UI_Student) and via API (TEST_proof.pdf) — these create file_refs entries + event_scholarship submissions tagged TEST_*. Not auto-cleaned. No production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 features ALL verified. Backend: 7 new tests in TestUploadAndAdminDownload + TestContentPersistence in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. UI flow at /events/{eventId}/scholarship: data-testids proof-file-pick, proof-file-input, proof-file-attached, proof-file-clear all wired correctly. Admin Submissions tab shows download-proof-{submission_id} buttons; clicking triggers fetch /api/admin/files/{file_id} with Bearer + opens blob in new tab (Playwright popup detection is unreliable for fetch->window.open patterns; verify via response capture instead). Storage backend (emergent objstore) returned 200 throughout testing — no 503s observed. Content polling: not directly UI-instrumented in this run since hero_label persistence is already verified at API level (PUT /content as admin → GET /content unauth returns updated value).
